The Minimum Wages Act, 1948 (Central Act XI of 1948) - Revision of minimum rates of
wages for employment in Shops and Commercial Establishments - Preliminary
Notification - Confirmation - Orders - Issued.

2. G.O.(D) No.343, Labour Welfare and Skill Development (J1)
Department, dated 07.07.2022.

3. From the Principal Secretary / Commissioner of Labour,
Chennai - 600 006, Letter No.Z3/10011/2022, dated 01.08.2023.

ORDER:

In the Government Order first read above, the minimum rates of wages for the
employment in Shops and Commercial Establishments were revised under the
provisions of the Minimum Wages Act, 1948 (Central Act XI of 1948).

2. In the Government Order second read above, a Preliminary Notification was
published in order to revise the minimum rates of wages further for the above said
employment.

3. The Principal Secretary / Commissioner of Labour in his letter third read
above, has stated that no objections and suggestions were received from the persons
likely to be affected by such revision and has requested the Government to confirm the
above said Preliminary Notification.

4. The Government have now decided to confirm the orders issued in the said
Preliminary Notification, without any modification.

5. The appended Notification will accordingly be published in the Tamil Nadu
Government_Gazette both in English and Tamil. The Works Manager, Government
Central Press, Chennai-600 001 is requested to publish the Notification and send each
five copies of the Gazette to the Government and to the Commissioner of Labour,

APPENDIX.
NOTIFICATION.

In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (b) of sub-section (1) of section 3
and sub-section (2) of section 5 of the Minimum Wages Act, 1948 (Central Act XI of
1948) and in supersession of the Labour and Employment Department Notification
No. Ti(2)/LE/205(m)/2019 published at pages 1-6 of Part || Section 2 of the Tamil Nadu
Government Gazette, dated the 5th March 2019, the “Governor of Tamil Nadu, after
consultation with the Advisory Board, hereby revises the minimum rates of wages
payable to the classes of employees in the Employment in Shops and Commercial
Establishments in the State of Tamil Nadu, specified in column(1) of the Schedule
below, as specified in the corresponding entries in column (2) thereof, the draft of the
same having been previously published as required by clause (b) of sub-section (1) of
section 5 of the said Act.

2. This Notification shall come into force with effect on and from the date of its
publication in the Tamil Nadu Government Gazette.

title: TN Minimum Wages Shops Commercial Establishments GO65 Confirmation 2024
content:
(ii) The dearness allowance shall be calculated every year on the first April on the

basis of the average of the consumer price indices for the preceding 12 months
that is from January to December; and

(iii) The first calculation of the dearness allowance shall thus, be effective from the
date of publication of this Notification in the Tamil Nadu Government Gazette

based on the average Chennai City Consumer Price Index for the previous year,
‘that is-from January to December.

(2) The classification of zones shall be as follows:-

(i) Zone -A : All Corporations and Special Grade Municipalities.

(ii) Zone -— B : All Municipalities other than Special Grade Municipalities.
(iii) Zone -— C : All Townships, Town Panchayats and Cantonments.

(iv) Zone -D:

All places other than those mentioned in Zones A, B and C.

(3) Where the nature of work is the same, no distinction in the payment of wages shall
be made between men and women employees.

(4) To arrive at daily rates of wages, the monthly wages shall be divided by 26.

(5) Wherever the existing wages are higher than the minimum wages fixed herein
such higher wages shall be continued to be paid.

K. VEERA RAGHAVA RAO
SECRETARY TO GOVERNMENT
